idea-plugin.name: Veyra Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A warm, modern dark and light theme in the FlightCoders colours: coral, amber and violet on deep ink.

Veyra Theme is the look of Veyra Studio, brought to every JetBrains IDE.

Two themes

  • Veyra Dark: a deep ink-violet background that is easy on the eyes for long sessions, with glowing coral, amber and violet accents.
  • Veyra Light: soft lavender paper with crisp, high-contrast code.

Every pixel themed

  • The whole IDE: toolbars, tool windows, tabs, popups, search, dialogs, the Run widget, notifications and checkboxes. On 2025.3 and newer you get the rounded Islands look.
  • Signature details: coral-to-violet default buttons, a coral caret and tab underline, an amber current line number, and an amber-to-violet progress bar.
  • Matching editor colour schemes for Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SQL, Go, Rust, PHP, Markdown and more, plus the debugger, diffs, VCS, search highlights and the terminal.

How to use it

Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Appearance → Theme and pick Veyra Dark or Veyra Light. The matching editor colour scheme switches with it.

Made by FlightCoders, the team behind Veyra Studio and the Veyra extensions.
